pre_registration.commit: the commit with subject "research: pre-register decision method and archetypal objective"; resolve with: git log --format=%H --fixed-strings --grep="research: pre-register decision method and archetypal objective" -- research/methods/thresholds.json
pre_registration.note: A file cannot contain the SHA of the commit that adds it; the commit is resolved by the command above (decision-method.md Appendix A.1). The earlier WIP checkpoint 3fda801 already carried status pre-registered but is not the pre-registration record (decision-method.md §0.1).

authority: research/decision-method.md is authoritative. Every non-null value here is transcribed from it and cites the section in source / decision_method_section. null = unset or intentionally null; ebr refuses verdicts that need an unset value and never substitutes a default.

semantics.practical_significance_band: kind 'ratio': candidate/baseline paired median ratios inside [lower, upper] are practically equivalent; kind 'absolute': differences (candidate - baseline, metric units) inside [lower, upper]. A difference is distinguishable only if the whole CI lies outside the band.
semantics.pareto_epsilon: kind 'relative': fractional tolerance (a is not worse than b if a <= b*(1+value) for minimised metrics, compared in log space); kind 'absolute': metric units.
semantics.metric_thresholds: relative r: band [1/(1+r), 1+r]; absolute a: difference band [-a, +a]; composite rule, floor handling and epsilon = band per decision-method.md §3.1; relative_by_profile overrides relative per profile; absolute_by_tier overrides absolute per scale tier; absolute_rule is evaluated per experiment; minimum-gain band at tier multiplier k is [(1+r)^-k, (1+r)^k] for relative bands and min(k*a, minimum_gain_cap) for absolute-only metrics (§3.1, §7.3). Roles: banded (may be primary), diagnostic (primary only when the decision is about that component), secondary_only, sensitivity_arm (§6.5 only), binary (§3.3; any failure is R1/R2), descriptive (reported; never eliminates or selects), cost_input (feeds §7 cost elements and tiers), heuristic (simulated sessions; no CI verdicts, §4.16).

other.description: Custom metrics not covered by another family
other.note: Intentionally null by pre-registered design: no family-wide band is meaningful for counts, bits, percentage points, fractions and speedups; metric_thresholds governs.

bootstrap.note: ebr enforces resamples >= 10000 regardless of this value. confidence is the base two-sided per-comparison confidence; resamples applies to every bootstrap interval ebr computes (informational per §3.6).
bootstrap.superiority_confidence_rule: 1 - 0.01 / k_sup (k_sup = superiority metrics declared for the pair)

statistics.one_sided_0_95_rule: unfavourable bound of the two-sided 0.90 interval

quiet_machine_guard.note: Required before any timing=true run; ebr refuses timing runs while unset. max_loadavg_1m is the WSL envelope (1.0 + 8 threads); decision specs set guard.max_loadavg_1m = 1.0 + n_threads (§4.4).

drift_canary.min_duration_rule: max(1 s, median sample wall), at most 60 s

confidence.t3_t4_selection_requires: HIGH, or an owner acceptance record naming each soft cap

cost_tiers.multiplier_semantics: log-consistent: band half-width k*ln(1+r); absolute-only: min(k*a, minimum_gain_cap)
